# ToolsOfSaaS - Core Directory & Resources

> ToolsOfSaaS (https://toolsofsaas.com/) is a curated directory of fast, 100% free browser-based micro-tools and software-as-a-service (SaaS) utilities. All client tools execute locally on the user's device with zero signups, zero server data storage, and complete privacy.

## Navigation & Discovery
- [Homepage](https://toolsofsaas.com/)
- [All Free Web Tools Directory](https://toolsofsaas.com/tools/)
- [Sitemap](https://toolsofsaas.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Official Blog](https://toolsofsaas.com/blog/)
- [About Us](https://toolsofsaas.com/about/)
- [Contact Information](https://toolsofsaas.com/contact/)

## Featured Web Utilities
- [Amazon Affiliate Commission Calculator](https://toolsofsaas.com/tools/amazon-affiliate-commission-calculator/): Calculate projected Amazon Associates earnings by category tier across 21+ global storefronts with live exchange rates and Excel/Sheets export.
- [Random Team Generator & Multiday Planner](https://toolsofsaas.com/tools/random-team-generator/): Intelligent grouping tool and multi-round rotation scheduler. Built with a pairing algorithm that minimizes teammate repeat matches across days, rounds, and classroom sessions.
- [Fair Chore Assigner & Schedule Rotator](https://toolsofsaas.com/tools/chore-assigner/): Household task assigner and fair cleanup chart generator. Uses weighted difficulty scores and rotation schedules to equitably balance duties across roommates or family members.
- [AI Color Palette Generator](https://toolsofsaas.com/tool/color-palette-gen/): Curated tool to generate harmonized color schemes, export HEX/RGB tokens, and test accessible contrast ratios.
- [ErrorFixer Diagnostic Platform](https://toolsofsaas.com/tool/errorfixer-smart-error-detection-and-resolution-platform/): Automated debugging and exception diagnostics platform for modern software stacks.
